query: A Lantern Washes Up Weeks after Lantern Night a lantern washes up at your feet on the shore, burnt out, the wish still folded inside it. The handwriting is neat and nervous. Read it It's a wish about someone, a student who "never notices anything". You recognise the handwriting from the library sign-out book, and say nothing, ever. Send it back out unread You relight the stub with a snap of your fingers and push it out again. It wobbles off over the water, its secret intact, and you never find out.
